practice._description: Carolina Podiatry Center is a Hickory, NC podiatry practice led by Dr. William J. Johncock, DPM, providing foot and ankle care for heel pain, sports injuries, nail problems, diabetic foot concerns, wound care, and surgical foot conditions.
practice.name: Carolina Podiatry Center
practice.tagline: Quality foot care for the long run
practice.short_description: Quality foot care for the long run from a Hickory, NC podiatry practice focused on conservative and surgical foot care, sports injuries, heel pain, nail care, and diabetic foot concerns.
practice.custom_note: Public directory and mirrored site sources describe Carolina Podiatry Center as a Hickory podiatry practice led by Dr. William J. Johncock, DPM, with conservative and surgical foot care and a sports medicine focus.

doctor._description: Assigned provider details. Leave blank in unassigned mode. Do not show doctor-specific credentials, photos, years, or certification claims unless these fields are populated and has_assigned_doctor is true.
doctor.name: William J. Johncock
doctor.title: Podiatrist and Foot & Ankle Surgeon
doctor.bio_short: Dr. William J. Johncock is a Hickory podiatrist associated with Carolina Podiatry Center. Public directory listings describe his practice focus as conservative and surgical foot care, with attention to sports-related foot and ankle problems.
doctor.board_certification_claim: Public mirrored site listings reference American Board of Podiatric Surgery certification. Confirm with the office before using stronger credential copy.
board_certifications: American Board of Podiatric Surgery, public listing, confirm current status before final publication
doctor.custom_note: Avoid ratings claims. Use sports medicine and long-run positioning because public photos/reviews support that tone.

contact._description: Public contact and location details. Only make proximity, parking, accessibility, or map claims if the matching policy/location fields below support them.
contact.custom_note: Google Business Profile map embed supplied by client.

hours._description: Public office hours. Use these for display only. Do not infer walk-in, emergency, same-day, or after-hours availability from hours alone.
hours.custom_note: Current office hours were not confirmed during research. Use call-to-confirm language until verified.

reviews._description: Review display guardrails. Do not show star ratings, review counts, testimonials, or review widgets unless enabled and supported by real source data or manual reviews.
reviews.custom_note: Do not show ratings/review score. GBP rating is not strong enough for marketing use.

social._description: Public social/profile URLs. Empty values should not render.

integrations._description: Third-party tracking and app integrations. Empty values should not render scripts.

forms._description: Lead capture form settings. Leave embed_html blank in the base template. Paste tenant-specific GHL or other embed code only when building an assigned site.
forms._how_to_update: Paste your full GHL (or other) embed snippet into embed_html. JSON requires escaped inner double quotes and line breaks. The build pipeline should dedupe duplicate script tags automatically across forms.

branding._description: Brand identity and visual tokens. These should drive global CSS variables, favicon links, logo display, and tenant-level color changes.

typography.heading_font_fallback: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
typography.body_font_fallback: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

logo_text_style._description: Controls the optional text beside an image-only logo. Use logo_text_mode 'image_only' when a tenant provides a full wordmark/logo that already includes text.

copy_rules._description: Content guardrails for AI and templates. These fields help keep copy aligned with the style guide and prevent drift between provider-site and directory-site language.

keywords._description: Keyword guidance for titles, headings, body copy, blog posts, and internal links. Use naturally and avoid city or keyword stuffing.

blog_long_tail_strategy._description: Blog posts should target long-tail searches from the sitemap/blog matrix. Use the page topic, condition, treatment, symptom, comparison, cost, timeline, and local modifiers naturally.
patterns: when to see a foot doctor for [condition]
how long does [condition] take to heal

appointments._description: Appointment and booking claims. Templates should only mention same-week, same-day, no-referral, walk-in, emergency, or response-time claims when explicitly enabled here.
appointments.custom_note: Appointment speed, urgent availability, referral requirements, and new patient visit length were not verified. Use cautious call-to-confirm language.

policies._description: Tenant-specific patient policies and amenities. Empty or false fields should not be claimed in copy.
policies.custom_note: Public details were not enough to confirm parking, accessibility, languages, cancellation policy, payment methods, financing, HSA/FSA, or emergency policy. Keep those claims out of copy until confirmed by the office.

equipment._description: Equipment and in-office capabilities. Do not mention X-rays, ultrasound, laser, shockwave device brands, 3D scanning, or surgery capabilities unless enabled here.
equipment.custom_note: Extremity X-ray and surgical/procedure listings were found in public directory/context research. Shockwave, laser, ultrasound, onsite MRI, CT, and orthotic scanning were not confirmed, so service pages may exist for site breadth but equipment-specific claims should stay gated.

services._description: Service availability guardrails. If enabled is false, hide service pages, cards, CTAs, FAQs, pricing, and related links unless tenant_overrides force the page to show.

shockwave_therapy.label: Shockwave Therapy
shockwave_therapy.custom_note: Content can discuss shockwave generally when this service is enabled, but device-specific claims require equipment.shockwave fields.

foot_surgery.label: Foot Surgery
foot_surgery.custom_note: Only use surgery positioning when the tenant actually offers surgical care.

sports_foot_care.label: Sports Foot Care
sports_foot_care.custom_note: Supported by public review/photo signals and mirrored site copy describing sports medicine focus.

nail_care.label: Nail Care and Nail Removal
nail_care.custom_note: WebMD lists nail infection, thickened nails, and removal/destruction/excision/drainage procedures.

wound_care.label: Wound Care
wound_care.custom_note: WebMD lists venous skin ulcer and debridement-related procedures.

navigation._description: Primary and footer navigation. In the final template, links should be filtered against publish flags and service availability before rendering.

schema._description: Structured data defaults. Only include precise geo, price, review, doctor, or service schema when config has accurate values.

features._description: High-level feature toggles for optional site modules.

custom_value_props._description: Tenant-specific value props. If disabled or empty, templates should use safe generic value props that do not make unsupported claims.

publishing._description: Sitemap-driven publishing controls. The final generator should respect publish flags and tenant overrides when creating pages and navigation.

pricing._description: Pricing display guardrails. Do not show exact prices, financing, HSA/FSA, or package pricing unless enabled and populated here.
pricing.default_disclaimer: Pricing varies by condition, provider, insurance, and treatment plan. Contact the clinic to confirm current options.

insurance_providers._description: Insurance display guardrails. If enabled is false, do not claim accepted carriers. Use cautious verify-coverage language instead. Only add providers when real insurance details and logo files are available.
insurance_providers.custom_note: No practice-owned or site-confirmed insurance list was available in the research notes. Do not list carrier acceptance unless the office confirms it.
insurance_providers.section_subtitle: Call Carolina Podiatry Center to verify current coverage for your plan.
insurance_providers.disclaimer: Insurance participation can vary by provider, plan, and location. Verify coverage with your carrier and Carolina Podiatry Center before your visit.
insurance_providers.fallback_text: Insurance details were not confirmed from a practice-owned source. Call the office before booking to verify current coverage.
